PhD Chapter 3 - RelativeSize

Emanuele Giacomuzzo

2023-02-08 10:30:55

Experiment

Design

Preparation

culture_info = read.csv(here("data", "RelativeSize_culture_info.csv"), header = TRUE)

Pipette tips

tips_per_box_yellow = 92
tips_per_box_blue = 92
tips_per_box_green = 24
nr_cultures = max(culture_info$culture_ID)
time_points = 8
n_exchanges = 6
extra_tips_factor = 1.5
yellow_tips_needed = nr_cultures * time_points * extra_tips_factor

yellow_boxes_needed = yellow_tips_needed / tips_per_box_yellow
yellow_boxes_needed = ceiling(yellow_boxes_needed)

green_tips_needed = nr_cultures * n_exchanges * extra_tips_factor

green_boxes_needed = green_tips_needed / tips_per_box_green
green_boxes_needed = ceiling(green_boxes_needed)

Pipette tips I’ll need are:

  • Yellow tips for taking the videos. I’ll need 26 boxes for the whole experiment (3.25 boxes per time point).

  • Green tips for exchanging resources between cultures. I’ll need 72 boxes for the whole experiment (12 boxes per time point).

PPM & Bacterial solution

#Parameters for the PPM 

pellet_per_litre_needed_g = 0.46

#Parameters for the bacterial solutions

volume_bacs_bottles = 0.2

#Parameters for the high-density cultures (L)

volume_HDC = 0.2

HDC_ratio_protists = 0.10
HDC_ratio_bacs = 0.05
HDC_ratio_PPM = 0.85

n_initial_HDC = 90
n_HDC_first_check = 20
n_HDC_second_check = 20

n_HDC = n_initial_HDC + n_HDC_first_check + n_HDC_second_check
extra_PPM_factor = 1.5
#PPM needed

PPM_needed_for_HDC = n_HDC * volume_HDC * HDC_ratio_PPM

PPM_needed_for_bacs = n_HDC *
                      volume_HDC *
                      HDC_ratio_bacs

PPM_needed = ceiling((PPM_needed_for_HDC + PPM_needed_for_bacs) *
                       extra_PPM_factor)

pellet_needed_g = PPM_needed * pellet_per_litre_needed_g
#Bacs bottles needed - Initial 

volume_initial_HDC = n_initial_HDC * volume_HDC

bacs_volume_needed_initial = volume_initial_HDC * HDC_ratio_bacs

bacs_bottles_needed_initial = ceiling((bacs_volume_needed_initial / volume_bacs_bottles) * extra_PPM_factor)

#Bacs bottles needed - First check

volume_first_check_HDC = n_HDC_first_check * volume_HDC

bacs_volume_needed_first_check = volume_first_check_HDC * HDC_ratio_bacs

bacs_bottles_needed_first_check = ceiling((bacs_volume_needed_first_check /
                                             volume_bacs_bottles) * extra_PPM_factor)

#Bacs bottles needed - Second check

volume_second_check_HDC = n_HDC_second_check *
  volume_HDC

bacs_volume_needed_second_check = volume_second_check_HDC *
  HDC_ratio_bacs

bacs_bottles_needed_second_check = ceiling((bacs_volume_needed_second_check /
                                              volume_bacs_bottles) *
                                             extra_PPM_factor)

  • PPM needed: 36 litres

  • Pellet needed: 16.56 grams

  • Bacs needed for the initial high-density cultures: 7 bottles (200 ml)

  • Bacs needed for the first check of the high-density cultures: 2 bottles (200 ml)

  • Bacs needed for the second check of the high-density cultures: 2bottles (200 ml)

Protist monocultures from my collection

bottles_Eug_initial = 20
bottles_other_protists_initial = 7
#Volume needed of Euglena to create the high-density cultures

Eug_volume_needed_initial_HDC = bottles_Eug_initial * volume_HDC

Eug_initial_needed = Eug_volume_needed_initial_HDC *
                     HDC_ratio_protists

## Volume needed of all other protists to create the high-density cultures

volume_HDC_initial_others = bottles_other_protists_initial *
                                              volume_HDC

other_protists_initial_needed = volume_HDC_initial_others *
                                HDC_ratio_protists

  • Volume needed from my collection to start the high-density cultures of Eug: 400 ml

  • Volume needed from my collection to start the high-density cultures of all other protists: 140 ml

High-density cultures (HDC)

n_other_protists = 10
extra_HDC_factor = 1.25
#Volume needed of each of the high-density cultures to assemble the experiment

volume_needed_total = (sum(culture_info$patch_size_ml) * extra_HDC_factor) / 1000 

volume_needed_Eug = volume_needed_total/2
volume_needed_others = volume_needed_total/2
volume_needed_ech_protist = volume_needed_others / n_other_protists

## Euglena

bottles_HDC_Eug_needed = ceiling((volume_needed_Eug / volume_HDC))

## All other protists

bottles_HDC_other_protists_needed = ceiling((volume_needed_ech_protist / volume_HDC))

  • Eug high-density cultures bottles needed to assemble the experiment: 12 (I need 2.2629 litres of Eug)

  • All other protists high-density cultures bottles needed to assemble the experiment: 2 per protist (I need 0.22629 litres of each other protist)

PPM + Bacs big bottle first time high-density

extra_PPM_mixing_bottle_factor = 1.20
PPM_needed_for_initial_HDC = volume_initial_HDC * HDC_ratio_PPM * extra_PPM_mixing_bottle_factor

bacs_needed_for_initial_HDC = volume_initial_HDC * HDC_ratio_bacs * extra_PPM_mixing_bottle_factor

min_size_mixing_bottle = ceiling(PPM_needed_for_initial_HDC +
                                 bacs_needed_for_initial_HDC)

  • PPM needed for the initial HDC, which I will mix into the mixing bottle: 18.36

  • Bacterial solution needed for the initial HDC, which I will mix into the mixing bottle: 1.08

Experimental cultures (culture_info)

This dataset contains information about the 192 cultures of the experiment.

          options = list(scrollX = TRUE),
          filter = list(position = 'top', 
                        clear = FALSE))

treatments_and_controls = data.frame(
  treatment = c(
    "AutoS_absolute_connected",
    "AutoSM_absolute_connected",
    "AutoML_absolute_connected",
    "AutoL'_absolute_connected",
    "HeteroS_absolute_connected",
    "HeteroSM_absolute_connected",
    "HeteroML_absolute_connected",
    "HeteroL_absolute_connected",
    "AutoS_relative_connected",
    "AutoSM_relative_connected",
    "AutoML_relative_connected",
    "AutoL'_relative_connected",
    "HeteroS_relative_connected",
    "HeteroSM_relative_connected",
    "HeteroML_relative_connected",
    "HeteroL_relative_connected"
    ),
  control = c(
    "AutoS_absolute",
    "AutoSM_absolute",
    "AutoML_absolute",
    "AutoL'_absolute",
    "HeteroS_absolute",
    "HeteroSM_absolute",
    "HeteroML_absolute",
    "HeteroL_absolute",
    "AutoS_relative",
    "AutoSM_relative",
    "AutoML_relative",
    "AutoL'_relative",
    "HeteroS_relative",
    "HeteroSM_relative",
    "HeteroML_relative",
    "HeteroL_relative"
  )
)

n_of_treatments = nrow(treatments_and_controls)

row_n = 0
for (treatment_n in 1:n_of_treatments) {
  for (time_point_input in first_time_point:last_time_point) {
    row_n = row_n + 1
    
    eco_metaeco_treatment = treatments_and_controls$treatment[treatment_n]
    
    treatment_row = ds_patches_effect_size %>%
      filter(
        eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_treatment,
        time_point == time_point_input
      )
    
    eco_metaeco_control = treatments_and_controls$control[treatment_n]
    
    control_row = ds_patches_effect_size %>%
      filter(
        eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_control,
        time_point == time_point_input
      )
    
    ### Bioarea density
    
    hedges_d_bioarea = calculate.hedges_d(
      treatment_row$bioarea_per_volume_mean,
      treatment_row$bioarea_per_volume_sd,
      treatment_row$sample_size,
      control_row$bioarea_per_volume_mean,
      control_row$bioarea_per_volume_sd,
      control_row$sample_size
    )
    
    ds_patches_effect_size$bioarea_per_volume_d[
      ds_patches_effect_size$eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_treatment &
        ds_patches_effect_size$time_point == time_point_input] =
      hedges_d_bioarea$d
    
    ds_patches_effect_size$bioarea_per_volume_d_upper[
      ds_patches_effect_size$eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_treatment &
        ds_patches_effect_size$time_point == time_point_input] =
      hedges_d_bioarea$upper_CI
    
    ds_patches_effect_size$bioarea_per_volume_d_lower[
      ds_patches_effect_size$eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_treatment &
        ds_patches_effect_size$time_point == time_point_input] =
      hedges_d_bioarea$lower_CI
    
    ds_patches_effect_size$bioarea_per_volume_lnRR[
      ds_patches_effect_size$eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_treatment &
        ds_patches_effect_size$time_point == time_point_input] =
      ln(treatment_row$bioarea_per_volume_mean / control_row$bioarea_per_volume_mean)

    #                                             ds_patches_effect_size$disturbance == disturbance_input] =
    #   hedges_d_indiv_per_volume$d
    # 
    # ds_patches_effect_size$indiv_per_volume_d_lower[ds_patches_effect_size$eco_metaeco_type == eco_metaeco_treatment &
    #                                                   ds_patches_effect_size$time_point == time_point_input &
    #                                                   ds_patches_effect_size$disturbance == disturbance_input] =

Meta-ecosystems (ds_metaecosystems)

  • Each row is a meta-ecosystem.
ds_metaecosystems = ds_patches %>%
  filter(metaecosystem == "yes") %>%
  group_by(day,
           system_nr,
           time_point,
           patch_size_ml,
           patch_size,
           flow,
           metaecosystem_type) %>%
  summarise(bioarea_per_volume = sum(bioarea_per_volume))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'day', 'system_nr', 'time_point',
## 'patch_size_ml', 'patch_size', 'flow'. You can override using the `.groups`
## argument.
#Compute meta-ecosystems biodiversity

ds_metaecosystems_single_rows = NULL
row_n = 0
for (combination in 1:number_of_combinations){
  for (time_point_input in first_time_point:last_time_point) {
    
    row_n = row_n + 1
    
    current_system_nr = ID_combinations[combination,]$system_nr
    current_IDs = ID_combinations[combination,1:2]
    current_disturbance = ID_combinations[combination,]$disturbance
    current_metaeco_type = ID_combinations[combination,]$metaecosystem_type
    current_day = sampling_days[time_point_input+1]
    
    if (current_system_nr %in% metaecosystems_to_take_off)
      next
    
    species_density_of_the_two_patches = ds_patches %>%
      filter(culture_ID %in% current_IDs,
             time_point == time_point_input) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(Ble:Tet)
    
    #Alpha diversity: Shannon (mean between the two patches)
    shannon_patch_1 = diversity(species_density_of_the_two_patches[1,], index = "shannon")
    shannon_patch_2 = diversity(species_density_of_the_two_patches[2,], index = "shannon")
    shannon = (shannon_patch_1 + shannon_patch_2) / 2
    
    #Beta diversity: Jaccard

    jaccard_index = vegdist(species_density_of_the_two_patches, 
                            method = "jaccard") %>%
                    as.numeric()
    
    #Beta diversity: Bray Curtis
    
    bray_curtis = vegdist(species_density_of_the_two_patches, 
                          method = "bray") %>%
                    as.numeric()
    
    #Gamma diversity: Meta-ecosystem richness
    
    presence_absence_two_patches = ifelse(test = species_density_of_the_two_patches > 0,
                                          yes = 1,
                                          no = 0)
    
    summed_columns = colSums(presence_absence_two_patches)
    
    presence_absence_metaecosystem = ifelse(test = summed_columns > 0,
                              yes = 1,
                              no = 0)
    
    metaecosystem_richness = sum(presence_absence_metaecosystem)
    
    #Gamma diversity: Shannon
    
    averaged_species_density_of_the_two_patches = species_density_of_the_two_patches %>%
      map_dbl(function(x) if(is.numeric(x)) mean(x) else NA)
      
    gamma_shannon = diversity(averaged_species_density_of_the_two_patches, 
                              index = "shannon")
    
    #Put everything together
    
    ds_metaecosystems_single_rows[[row_n]] = ds_patches %>%
    filter(culture_ID %in% current_IDs,
           time_point == time_point_input) %>%
    summarise(total_metaecosystem_bioarea = sum(bioarea_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Ble = sum(Ble_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Cep = sum(Cep_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Col = sum(Col_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Eug = sum(Eug_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Eup = sum(Eup_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Lox = sum(Lox_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Pau = sum(Pau_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Pca = sum(Pca_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Spi = sum(Spi_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Spi_te = sum(Spi_te_tot),
              total_metaecosystem_Tet = sum(Tet_tot)) %>% 
    mutate(system_nr = current_system_nr,
           metaecosystem_type = current_metaeco_type,
           disturbance = current_disturbance,
           time_point = time_point_input,
           day = current_day,
           jaccard_index = jaccard_index,
           bray_curtis = bray_curtis,
           metaecosystem_richness = metaecosystem_richness,
           gamma_shannon = gamma_shannon,
           mean_shannon = shannon) %>%
      ungroup()
    
  }
}

ds_metaecosystems = ds_metaecosystems_single_rows %>%
  bind_rows()
ds_metaecosystems = as.data.frame(ds_metaecosystems)
saveRDS(ds_metaecosystems, file = here("results", "ds_metaecosystems.RData"))
datatable(ds_metaecosystems,
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(scrollX = TRUE),
          filter = list(position = 'top', 
                        clear = FALSE))

  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = day,
      y = bioarea_per_volume,
      group = interaction(day, patch_size_ml),
      color = patch_size_ml
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = resource_flow_days,
    linetype = resource_flow_line_type,

  labs(
    x = x_axis_date, 
    y = y_axis_patch_bioarea,
    color = ""

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = legend_position
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             color = zero_line_colour,
             linetype = zero_line_line_type,
             size = zero_line_size)

             y = bioarea_per_volume,
             group = interaction(day, patch_size_ml),
             fill = patch_size_ml)) +
  geom_boxplot()
